title: Motion set
description: data/input/motions.json: motion inputs, their priority and the input timing (ADR-0002; matching rules in data/README.md). Editor aid only: Sim.Data's validator is authoritative and repeats these rules (src/Sim.Data/Motions). Motions must be unique; consecutive steps must not share a direction; every window plus buttonBuffer must fit the 64-frame input history.

motionWindow.description: Default frames from a motion's first step to its button press. Copied into MatchRules.MotionWindow.

buttonBuffer.description: Frames a press stays valid: 2 accepts a press 2 frames ago, not 3. Copied into MatchRules.ButtonBuffer.

movementInputs.description: Which motions (from the motions list) dash, backdash and high jump; the optional dash button dashes, or backdashes when pressed with back.

highJump.description: Checked on the frame a prejump starts.

specialButton.description: A button id from input/buttons.json: with a move's input.shortcut direction it starts that move (ADR-0020).

motions.description: Priority order: when several motions are input on the same frame with the same button, the first one listed wins.

motion.description: Numpad notation, as moves refer to it in input.motion.

steps.description: Steps oldest first, separated by spaces; each step lists the directions that count for it ("123" = any down).

window.description: This motion's own window in frames, instead of motionWindow.
